div.head: Hn 7.3
div.ab: Agantur itaque primo debita uere christianitatis iura; secundo regis placita, postremo cause singulorum dignis satisfaccionibus expleantur.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 553 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

Comites uel iudices ad eorum placita primitus . . ecclesiarum causas definiant, postea alias; Fränk. Kapitular a. 755c. 23 (ed. Boretius Mon. Germ., Capit. p. 37). Comites uel iudices ad eorum placita primitus . . ecclesiarum causas definiant, postea alias; Frankish capitulary a. 755c. 23 (ed. Boretius Mon. Germ., Capit. p. 37). This is probably what Stubbs (Lect. p. 97) thinks was used here. To me, however, Hn, like ECf 3, seems to draw this only from living custom
